Hymn 72: Praise to the Lord, the Almighty
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Stralsund Gesangbuch
Lyricist/Text Author: Joachim Neander
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 72 titled "Praise to the Lord, the Almighty" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Stralsund Gesangbuch and the lyrics were written by Joachim Neander.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
